---
title: "Raw Milk Survey Analysis - 03: Outcome 2, Exclusive Raw Milk Consumption"
output: html_document
---

Model R_Exclusive: predictors of **exclusive** raw milk consumption
(`raw_only_binary`), among the same N = 898 analytic sample used in 02.

Run `01_data_cleaning.Rmd` first so `cleaned_survey_data.csv` exists in the
working directory.

The analytic dataset is built the same way as `data_final` in 02, so the two
outcomes share category definitions and reference levels exactly. The only
difference is the outcome: here, exclusive raw consumers (n = 58) versus
everyone else (n = 840).

Reference categories:

| Variable | Reference |
|---|---|
| Age group | 18–24 |
| Sex at birth | Female |
| Region | Midwest |
| Cohabitation with high-risk consumer | No at-risk member |
| Perceived taste | Equal |
| Nutrition beliefs | Equal |
| Perceived illness risk | Equal risk |
| H5N1 safety concern | No |
| Trusted information source | Doctors or nurses |
| Education | High school or less |
| Political orientation | Democrat |

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(gt)
library(pROC)
library(ResourceSelection)

survey_grouped <- read_csv("cleaned_survey_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## 1. Analytic dataset

Same construction as 02. Two things that are easy to break:

- `raw_milk_sickness` is renamed BEFORE the `across()` runs; that block treats
  "They are equal" as non-definitive, which would otherwise absorb a
  substantive response category for illness risk.
- Education and political orientation are restored to NA afterwards, so
  declining those questions is treated as missingness rather than becoming the
  reference level.

```{r data-rb}
predictors_miss <- c(
  "milk_safety_concern", "raw_milk_sickness", "taste_grouped2",
  "nutrition_grouped2", "household_risk_group", "age_grouped",
  "sex_at_birth", "region", "info_source", "education_grouped",
  "politics_grouped"
)

data_rb <- survey_grouped %>%
  mutate(raw_only_binary = case_when(
    milk_consumed == "Raw dairy milk" ~ 1,
    milk_consumed %in% c("Pasteurized dairy milk",
                         "Both raw and pasteurized dairy milk") ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_only_binary)) %>%
  mutate(raw_milk_sickness = if_else(raw_milk_sickness == "They are equal",
                                     "Equal risk", as.character(raw_milk_sickness))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(predictors_miss), ~ {
    val <- as.character(.)
    non_definitive <- is.na(val) |
      val %in% c("I don’t know", "I don't know", "Prefer not to answer",
                 "They are equal", "Missing", "")
    val[non_definitive] <- "Uncertain/Missing"
    factor(val)
  })) %>%
  mutate(across(c(education_grouped, politics_grouped),
                ~ factor(na_if(as.character(.), "Uncertain/Missing")))) %>%
  mutate(
    # Respondents who declined Q4 join the reference group, matching 02
    household_risk_group = fct_collapse(factor(household_risk_group),
      "No at-risk member" = c("No at-risk member", "Uncertain/Missing")),
    household_risk_group = fct_relevel(household_risk_group, "No at-risk member"),
    taste_grouped2       = fct_relevel(factor(taste_grouped2),       "Equal"),
    nutrition_grouped2   = fct_relevel(factor(nutrition_grouped2),   "Equal"),
    raw_milk_sickness    = fct_relevel(factor(raw_milk_sickness),    "Equal risk"),
    milk_safety_concern  = fct_relevel(factor(milk_safety_concern),  "No"),
    age_grouped          = fct_relevel(factor(age_grouped),          "18–24"),
    sex_at_birth         = fct_relevel(factor(sex_at_birth),         "Female"),
    region               = fct_relevel(factor(region),               "Midwest"),
    info_source          = fct_relevel(factor(info_source),          "Doctors or nurses"),
    education_grouped    = fct_relevel(factor(education_grouped),    "High school or less"),
    politics_grouped     = fct_relevel(factor(politics_grouped),     "Democrat"),
    outcome = factor(raw_only_binary, labels = c("Not Exclusive", "Exclusive Raw"))
  )

cat("Analytic sample:", nrow(data_rb), "\n")
cat("Exclusive raw consumers:", sum(data_rb$raw_only_binary), "\n\n")
cat("Reference level per predictor:\n")
for (v in predictors_miss) cat(" ", v, "->", levels(data_rb[[v]])[1], "\n")
```

## 2. Univariable analysis

Education and political orientation have smaller denominators because
respondents who declined those questions are excluded.

```{r univariable}
uv_vars <- c(
  age_grouped          = "Age Group",
  sex_at_birth         = "Sex at Birth",
  region               = "Geographic Region",
  taste_grouped2       = "Perceived Taste",
  nutrition_grouped2   = "Nutrition Beliefs",
  raw_milk_sickness    = "Perceived Illness Risk (Q7)",
  milk_safety_concern  = "H5N1 Safety Concern (Q8)",
  info_source          = "Trusted Information Source (Q3)",
  household_risk_group = "Cohabitation with High-Risk Consumer",
  education_grouped    = "Education Level",
  politics_grouped     = "Political Orientation"
)

make_uv_rb <- function(var) {
  d <- data_rb %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>% droplevels()

  tab  <- table(d[[var]], d$outcome)
  desc <- as.data.frame.matrix(tab)
  desc$total <- rowSums(desc)
  desc <- desc %>%
    mutate(Level   = rownames(desc),
           No_n    = `Not Exclusive`,
           No_pct  = round(100 * `Not Exclusive` / total, 1),
           Yes_n   = `Exclusive Raw`,
           Yes_pct = round(100 * `Exclusive Raw` / total, 1)) %>%
    select(Level, No_n, No_pct, Yes_n, Yes_pct)

  m <- glm(as.formula(paste("outcome ~", var)), data = d, family = binomial)

  est <- tidy(m, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(Level = trimws(gsub(var, "", term))) %>%
    select(Level, OR = estimate, CI_low = conf.low, CI_high = conf.high, p = p.value)

  left_join(desc, est, by = "Level") %>%
    mutate(variable = sprintf("%s (n = %d)", uv_vars[[var]], sum(tab)),
           var_raw  = var,
           Level    = factor(Level, levels = levels(d[[var]]))) %>%
    arrange(Level) %>%
    mutate(Level = as.character(Level))
}

uv_rb <- bind_rows(lapply(names(uv_vars), make_uv_rb)) %>%
  filter(No_n + Yes_n > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # Complete separation gives uninterpretable estimates; suppress rather than print
    estimable = !is.na(OR) & OR < 1000 & OR > 0.001 & !is.na(CI_low) & !is.na(CI_high),
    OR_CI = case_when(is.na(OR)  ~ "1.00 (Reference)",
                      !estimable ~ "Not estimable",
                      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", OR, CI_low, CI_high)),
    p_fmt = case_when(is.na(p)   ~ "—",
                      !estimable ~ "—",
                      p < 0.001  ~ "<0.001",
                      TRUE       ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)),
    Sig = !is.na(p) & estimable & p < 0.05,
    Level = Level %>%
      gsub("^No at-risk member$",  "No",  .) %>%
      gsub("^Has at-risk member$", "Yes", .)
  )

write_csv(uv_rb, "Univariable_Exclusive_Consumption.csv")

uv_rb %>%
  select(variable, Level, No_n, No_pct, Yes_n, Yes_pct, OR_CI, p_fmt, Sig) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "variable") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Univariable Logistic Regression: Exclusive Raw Milk Consumption",
             subtitle = paste0("Analytic sample (N = ", nrow(data_rb), ")")) %>%
  cols_label(Level = "Response Category",
             No_n = "n", No_pct = "%", Yes_n = "n", Yes_pct = "%",
             OR_CI = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)", p_fmt = "p-value") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Not exclusively raw", columns = c(No_n, No_pct)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Exclusively raw",     columns = c(Yes_n, Yes_pct)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = p_fmt, rows = Sig == TRUE)) %>%
  cols_hide(Sig) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = "13px", row_group.background.color = "#F9F9F9",
              data_row.padding = px(4), table.width = pct(100)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(No_n, No_pct, Yes_n, Yes_pct, p_fmt)) %>%
  tab_source_note(paste(
    "Reference categories listed first within each variable.",
    "Education and political orientation exclude respondents who declined to answer."))
```

```{r uv-screening}
screening <- uv_rb %>%
  group_by(variable, var_raw) %>%
  summarise(min_p = suppressWarnings(min(p[estimable], na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(carry_forward = ifelse(min_p < 0.10, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  arrange(min_p)

screening %>%
  mutate(min_p = sprintf("%.4f", min_p)) %>%
  select(variable, min_p, carry_forward) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Univariable Screening (p < 0.10)",
             subtitle = "Predictors carried forward to forward stepwise selection") %>%
  cols_label(variable = "Predictor", min_p = "Smallest p",
             carry_forward = "Carried forward")

candidate_pool <- screening$var_raw[screening$carry_forward == "Yes"]
cat("Candidate pool:", paste(candidate_pool, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 3. Forward stepwise selection

```{r stepwise}
get_aic_candidates <- function(base_formula, predictors, data) {
  base_aic <- AIC(glm(as.formula(base_formula), data = data, family = binomial))
  tab <- lapply(predictors, function(p) {
    m <- glm(as.formula(paste(base_formula, "+", p)), data = data, family = binomial)
    data.frame(Predictor = p, AIC = AIC(m))
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>% arrange(AIC)
  list(base_aic = base_aic, aic_table = tab)
}

selected <- character(0)
step_num <- 1
repeat {
  base_f <- paste("raw_only_binary ~",
                  if (length(selected) == 0) "1" else paste(selected, collapse = " + "))
  remaining <- setdiff(candidate_pool, selected)
  if (length(remaining) == 0) break

  res <- get_aic_candidates(base_f, remaining, data_rb)
  cat("\n=== Step", step_num, "=== base AIC:", round(res$base_aic, 2), "\n")
  print(res$aic_table)

  if (res$base_aic - res$aic_table$AIC[1] < 2) {
    cat("\nNo further improvement >= 2 AIC units. Selection complete.\n")
    break
  }
  selected <- c(selected, res$aic_table$Predictor[1])
  step_num <- step_num + 1
}

cat("\nSelected predictors:", paste(selected, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 4. Final multivariable model

```{r final-model}
final_model_rawonly <- glm(
  as.formula(paste("raw_only_binary ~", paste(selected, collapse = " + "))),
  data = data_rb, family = binomial
)

cat("Complete cases in final model:", length(final_model_rawonly$y),
    "of", nrow(data_rb), "\n")

final_table_rb <- tidy(final_model_rawonly, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = term %>%
      str_replace("taste_grouped2",       "Taste: ") %>%
      str_replace("nutrition_grouped2",   "Nutrition: ") %>%
      str_replace("age_grouped",          "Age: ") %>%
      str_replace("household_risk_group", "Cohabitation: ") %>%
      str_replace("milk_safety_concern",  "H5N1 Concern: ") %>%
      str_replace("raw_milk_sickness",    "Illness Risk: "),
    aOR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    p_fmt  = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
  )

write_csv(final_table_rb, "Table_4_Multivariable_RExclusive_Final.csv")

final_table_rb %>%
  select(term, aOR_CI, p_fmt) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Multivariable Predictors of Exclusive Raw Milk Consumption",
             subtitle = paste0("Adjusted odds ratios (N = ",
                               length(final_model_rawonly$y), ")")) %>%
  cols_label(term = "Variable & Category", aOR_CI = "aOR (95% CI)", p_fmt = "p-value") %>%
  tab_source_note(paste(
    "References: Age 18–24, Equal taste preference,",
    "and no at-risk household member."))
```

## 5. Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
roc_rb <- roc(final_model_rawonly$y, fitted(final_model_rawonly), quiet = TRUE)
hl_rb  <- hoslem.test(final_model_rawonly$y, fitted(final_model_rawonly), g = 10)

cat("AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc(roc_rb)), 4), "\n")
cat("Hosmer-Lemeshow X2:", round(as.numeric(hl_rb$statistic), 3),
    " df:", as.numeric(hl_rb$parameter),
    " p:", round(hl_rb$p.value, 4), "\n")

ggplot(data.frame(fpr = 1 - roc_rb$specificities, tpr = roc_rb$sensitivities),
       aes(x = fpr, y = tpr)) +
  geom_path(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste0("Model R_Exclusive ROC (AUC = ",
                      round(as.numeric(auc(roc_rb)), 3), ")"),
       x = "False positive rate (1 - specificity)",
       y = "True positive rate (sensitivity)")
```

Hosmer-Lemeshow may report fewer than `g - 2` degrees of freedom when the model
produces few distinct fitted probabilities; R merges bins and warns. That is
expected here and not an error.

## 6. Figure 2: forest plot

Built from `final_model_rawonly`, so it tracks whatever the stepwise selects.
`clean_level()` affects display labels only.

```{r forest-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
var_labels_rb <- c(
  taste_grouped2       = "Perceived Taste",
  age_grouped          = "Age Group",
  household_risk_group = "Cohabitation with\nHigh-Risk Consumer",
  nutrition_grouped2   = "Nutrition Beliefs",
  milk_safety_concern  = "H5N1 Safety Concern",
  raw_milk_sickness    = "Perceived Illness Risk"
)
# Keep only the predictors the model actually selected, in label order
model_vars_rb <- intersect(names(var_labels_rb), selected)
var_labels_rb <- var_labels_rb[model_vars_rb]

clean_level <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("Yes, if consuming either raw or pasteurized milk", "Yes, raw or pasteurized", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("Yes, if consuming pasteurized milk", "Yes, pasteurized only", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("Yes, if consuming raw milk",         "Yes, raw only",         x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("Uncertain/Missing",  "Uncertain/No Response", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("No at-risk member",  "No",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("Has at-risk member", "Yes", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

est_rb <- tidy(final_model_rawonly, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(var   = model_vars_rb[which(startsWith(term, model_vars_rb))][1],
         Level = sub(paste0("^", var), "", term)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(Variable = unname(var_labels_rb[var]), Level = clean_level(Level),
            aOR = estimate, Lower = conf.low, Upper = conf.high,
            p_value = p.value, is_ref = FALSE, var)

ref_rb <- lapply(model_vars_rb, function(v) {
  data.frame(Variable = unname(var_labels_rb[v]),
             Level = paste0(clean_level(levels(data_rb[[v]])[1]), " (ref)"),
             aOR = 1, Lower = NA_real_, Upper = NA_real_,
             p_value = NA_real_, is_ref = TRUE, var = v)
}) %>% bind_rows()

fd_rb <- bind_rows(ref_rb, est_rb) %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = model_vars_rb)) %>%
  arrange(var, is_ref == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Significance = case_when(
           is_ref ~ "Reference",
           !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
           TRUE ~ "Not Significant"),
         Unique_Row = factor(paste(Variable, Level, sep = " - "),
                             levels = rev(paste(Variable, Level, sep = " - "))))

gg_rb <- ggplot(fd_rb, aes(x = aOR, y = Unique_Row)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(data = filter(fd_rb, !is_ref),
                 aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper, color = Significance),
                 height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Significance, shape = Significance), size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 20),
                labels = c("0.02","0.05","0.1","0.25","0.5","1.0","2.5","5.0","10.0","20.0"),
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = setNames(fd_rb$Level, fd_rb$Unique_Row)) +
  facet_grid(Variable ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Reference" = "black", "p < 0.05" = "darkblue",
                                "Not Significant" = "gray60")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Reference" = 18, "p < 0.05" = 16,
                                "Not Significant" = 16)) +
  labs(x = "Adjusted Odds Ratio (aOR) on Log Scale (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = expression(bold("Multivariable Predictors of "*R[Exclusive])),
       color = "Statistical Significance", shape = "Statistical Significance") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing     = unit(1.0, "lines"),
    strip.placement   = "outside",
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", hjust = 1, size = 11,
                                     family = "Times New Roman", lineheight = 0.9),
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10, family = "Times New Roman",
                                margin = margin(r = 4)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, family = "Times New Roman"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11, family = "Times New Roman",
                                margin = margin(t = 8)),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 12)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 11, family = "Times New Roman"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 15, r = 50, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt"))

ggsave("GroupB_Forest_Plot.png", plot = gg_rb, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(gg_rb)
```
